data.title: Grant of Basic Income Support in Old Age (Grundsicherung im Alter)
data.summary: The Kreisverwaltung Beispiel-Westerwald (Sozialamt – Grundsicherung im Alter) informs Annika Beispielsteiner that she is granted basic income support in old age (Grundsicherung im Alter) of €412.64 per month starting December 2026, after her pension of €768.36 was counted as income and her full rent was covered.
data.explanation: This is a decision notice (Bescheid) from the social welfare office granting you monthly financial support starting December 2026, because your pension income was taken into account and your rent is covered in full. You don't need to do anything to receive the payments. If you disagree with the amount or any part of the decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) with the Kreisverwaltung; the app will show you the deadline by which it must arrive. If you take no action, the decision as issued becomes final.
